environment.recording: Nogizaka Under Construction, selected seek points; programme and commercial cadence not classified

normal_seek.interpretation: No measurable average seek improvement. Presentation variance dominates the 1.24 ms mean difference. An earlier after run had one 18 s presentation stall after successful append; it did not recur in the clean run.

forced_consecutive_seek.method: Set a second out-of-buffer currentTime when the first seek reports its first media append call.
forced_consecutive_seek.interpretation: Some resets began before the old media updateend, but the new init/media was not ready before that updateend. The browser run therefore did not reach the queue-corruption order reproduced by the deterministic SourceBuffer test. The after-only timeout occurred after the new media updateend and did not recur, so it is not evidence for or against the queue-generation fix.
